page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-192-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the c4d instance family. It features 192 dedicated virtual CPUs and 1512 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core. This high-density memory configuration is designed to support memory-intensive enterprise applications and large-scale data processing tasks.

The hardware profile provides a high ratio of memory to vCPUs without integrated GPU accelerators. While specific benchmark data is not available for this instance type, the dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance for workloads requiring massive parallel execution. The qualitative cost efficiency of this instance is characterized by its high resource density, making it suitable for consolidating large workloads onto a single high-capacity node.

This server configuration is suited for memory-optimized workloads, including large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy data warehousing, and complex analytics pipelines that require substantial memory capacity alongside high core counts.
